Name: Cat Lady Lucy (Custom NPC)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47214/47214-1780733993-498018396.png[/img][/center]
Lucia, who goes by Lucy, is a young woman who moved to Pelican Town from the city after having to drop out of vet school. She now works part-time in several businesses around Pelican Town to fund her own little cat shelter alongside her three pet cats Normie, Diva and Void. Despite her involvement in the local shops, she doesn't quite feel like she's a part of the community yet. Maybe befriending the new town farmer could help?

[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47214/47214-1780733644-1452149694.png[/img][/center]


[b]Shop Functionality [/b]
When Lucy is working for either Robin, Marnie or Clint while they are gone, you can access the respective item shop menus. This means that you can buy furniture/resources/recipes from Robin's, ore from Clint's, pet licenses and animal supplies from Marnie's, but the other shop menus are not available (building construction/upgrades, opening geodes, buying farm animals). Not until I learn some C#, at least...
--------
[b]Animal Catalogue[/b]
As of 1.0.3, Marnie's shop can still be opened the normal way using the animal catalogue on days that Lucy is working. Lucy's shop opens when you click on the tile below where Lucy stands, the regular shop menu opens when you click one tile to the left.
--------
[b]Nyapu-Style Portraits[/b]
Since I know a lot of people like to use them, I tried creating nyapu-style versions of all portraits (except for the void kitty) that can be enabled with GMCM (see config below). They could probably be a lot better, so please feel free to make and upload your own versions if you want.
--------
Note: there are some spoilers in the upcoming information around her. I've set information about heart event content as spoilers just in case.

[center][size=4][b]Compatibility & Permissions[/b][/size][/center]
[center]Due to map edit overlaps, Lucy's house is positioned slightly differently for Stardew Valley Expanded and Defense Division. This mod should be fully compatible with both. I have not tested with other expansions and NPCs, so please feel free to let me know if there are any major compatibility issues! I have not added recolored versions of my assets, but you are free to make and upload recolor compatibility if you wish. [/center]
[center]If you want to upload a recolor, portrait/sprite alterations, content expansions or any other additions to this mod, you may do so and use my assets as long as the mod you are uploading uses my mod as a dependency (without copying the entire mod) and you do not use AI to make it.[/center]
